Monika Zellner

sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm: full allocation for a firm two-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal trade.

On delivery, we agree to your quoted 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1).

On commitment, your letter of 18 September 2026 (doc:20260918-70410-P10) says you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We offer exactly that: a binding 23,400 pcs in each year over a 24-month term.

In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 27.50/unit. All other terms stay as enquired: DAP, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm: full allocation for a firm two-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month term at 23,400 units per year and your acceptance of the 54-day lead time.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For a contract term of 24 months and a volume of 23400 pcs per year, with a Lieferzeit of 54 days, we can offer a price of €31.70 per unit. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. The offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

proposal.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. Your note of 18 September says you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We are ready to give exactly that.

Our proposal:
- 23,400 pcs per year, binding for 36 months from 2027-01-01
- We accept your quoted 54-day lead time, so you can plan your capacity against it
- EUR 30.30 per unit; payment 30 days net, DAP, no index clause, no tooling

Your quotation of 19,890 pcs for 12 months would leave part of our need uncovered, so it does not work for us.

On price: our orders of 7 and 21 September 2026 were at EUR 29.89, and this price was unchanged in the last two renewals. The labour and producer price indices we track rose +2.66% and +3.90% over the last year, and they affect only part of the cost base. A three-year full-volume commitment also removes volume risk on your side.

If EUR 30.30 is not possible, please tell us which cost element prevents it, so we can discuss it concretely.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal trade.

On delivery, we can accept your 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1). On commitment, your letter of 18 September 2026 (doc:20260918-70410-P10) says you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We offer exactly that: a binding 24-month contract for 23,400 pcs in each year.

In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 29.89/unit. Payment would stay at 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, with no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
